news.title: ZFCVINDIA: Bonus Share Proposal And Capital Increase Will Support Future Tailwinds
news.body: Analysts have nudged their fair value estimate for ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India slightly higher, with the price target moving from ₹18,088.50 to ₹18,207.25. This reflects updated assumptions on revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E levels.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹273 (vs ₹243 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹273 (up from ₹243 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹43.0b (up 12% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹5.17b (up 12% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 12% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Auto Components industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 14% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 11% per year.

news.body: Analysts are maintaining their price target for ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India at ₹17,750, reflecting only minor adjustments to assumptions such as the discount rate, long-term revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E, which leave the overall valuation view essentially unchanged. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled on Feb 10, 2026 at 14:05 IST to review unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended Dec 31, 2025 and to consider and approve a postal ballot process to seek shareholder approval (Board Meeting).

news.title: ZFCVINDIA: ADAS Regulation Tailwinds Will Support Future Upside Potential
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India steady at ₹17,750, with only marginal tweaks to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E inputs. This signals no material shift in their underlying view of the stock at this time.

news.title: ZFCVINDIA: ADAS Regulation Opportunities Will Drive Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have raised their price target for ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India from ₹16,594 to ₹17,750, citing updated assumptions for profit margins, revenue growth, the discount rate and the future P/E ratio, which together indicate a higher assessed fair value. What's in the News Secured a business nomination from a leading e-mobility commercial vehicle OEM in India to develop and calibrate an ADAS suite tailored to upcoming Indian safety regulation GSR 184e, certified by ARAI and supporting SAE Level 2 automation, with potential for higher automation levels across coaches, heavy-duty trucks and tractor trailers (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹73.90 (vs ₹66.15 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹73.90 (up from ₹66.15 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹10.7b (up 12% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.40b (up 12% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 13% (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 21% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Auto Components industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 16% per year and the company’s share price has also increased by 16% per year.

news.title: ZFCVINDIA: ADAS Regulation And Tax Disputes Will Balance Future Prospects
news.body: Analysts have modestly reduced their price target on ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India to ₹16,594.20, reflecting slightly lower assumed discount rates and P/E multiples, while keeping revenue growth and profit margin expectations broadly unchanged. What's in the News The Income Tax Department issued a final assessment order for FY 2022-23 requiring ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India to pay additional tax of ₹11.7 million, following an addition of ₹32.3 million to total income related to transfer pricing and scientific research expenditure adjustments.

news.title: ZFCVINDIA: Future ADAS Safety Rules Will Drive Upside Despite Tax Disputes
news.body: Analysts have nudged their fair value estimate for ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India higher by ₹400 to ₹16,594.2, citing updated assumptions around revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E levels. What's in the News Company received a final assessment order from the Income Tax Department for FY 2022-23, with an additional tax demand of ₹11.7 million following an addition of ₹32.3 million to taxable income related to transfer pricing and scientific research expenditure; the company plans to appeal before the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (Key Developments).

news.title: ZFCVINDIA: Future ADAS Regulations Will Drive Upside Despite GST Risks
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India steady at ₹16,194.20 while making small adjustments to inputs such as the discount rate and forward P/E to reflect updated assumptions in their valuation models. What's in the News Company receives an order from the Additional Commissioner, CGST & Central Excise, Ranchi imposing a demand of ₹39,83,65,328 plus applicable interest and a penalty equal to the demand amount related to alleged incorrect GST classification of electronic control units for anti lock braking systems, with the company indicating no material impact on its financial, operations or other activities and planning to file an appeal (Regulatory Authority enforcement action).

news.title: ZFCVINDIA: Future ADAS Opportunity Will Offset GST Dispute Uncertainty
news.body: Analysts have maintained their price target for ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India at ₹16,194.20. This reflects unchanged fair value expectations despite minor tweaks to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and forward P/E assumptions.
